title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Register Standard: Annual Reward Eligibility of Sale Lines
content:
Whether a sale line of Northgate Purchases & Returns earns Annual Reward is fixed at the register and recorded on the line as its reward flag; returns, adjustments and rebates booked against the line copy the flag.

## Standard

A sale line earns Annual Reward only when all three conditions hold:

1. the channel is one whose purchases can earn Annual Reward;
2. the membership on the purchase was held at a Plus tier (Northgate Club Plus Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership) on the order date; and
3. the line's merchandise class is not among the classes that membership tier excludes from Annual Reward.

Purchases made through the same-day delivery partner never earn, whatever the member's tier. A flag recorded at the register is never changed later because the member upgrades, downgrades or presents another card.

## Combinations

| Channel can earn | Plus tier on the order date | Class excluded by the tier | Line earns Annual Reward |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | yes |
| yes | yes | yes | no |
| yes | no | no | no |
| no | yes | no | no |

## Questions answered by the standard

- *A member upgrades to Club Plus a week after a purchase made on a Club membership: does the earlier line start earning?* No; the flag recorded at the register stands.
- *Does a refund on an earning line carry the flag?* Yes; returns, adjustments and rebates against the line copy its flag.
